g.text: [until the circular buffer is empty, the writer would block
or the limit of slots per flush is exceeded]
Flush the data of the current message
[until all spans are written or the writer would block]
Errors and "would block" are ignored by Flush(). The data stays
in the NonBlockingWriter and the circular buffer and is written
by the next call of Flush(), which is also done in ReserveSlot().
